objective_value: <float> Total duration, in minutes, of pairings that are left uncovered by the roster assignments.

<key: '{crew_member_id}'>.roster_index: <int> Index of the chosen feasible monthly roster within this crew member's enumerated roster set.
<key: '{crew_member_id}'>.pairings: <list[int]> Identifiers of the pairings assigned to this crew member during the planning month.
<key: '{crew_member_id}'>.unproductive_time: <int> Minutes of the planning month during which this crew member is neither on a pairing nor on a pre-assigned activity.

uncovered_pairings.pairing_id: <int> Identifier of a pairing that no crew member is assigned to cover.
uncovered_pairings.uncovered_count: <int> Number of unfilled crew slots remaining on this pairing after roster assignment.
uncovered_pairings.duration_minutes: <int> Total elapsed minutes of this uncovered pairing from departure to return.
